entry.title: Rostec Arena
entry.note: Exact pitch long sides averaged to direct+Z north-northwest; model retains asymmetric mapped perimeter. Existing polygon hole marks grass margins, not roof aperture; roof aperture uses primary structural dimensions. Ground-floor piers and pitch are placed on terrainY0, raised circulation deck stands above it. Site landscaping and perimeter security buildings remain separate map features. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
